## Computer Vision in Metaverse

### Core Functions
- 3D user environment creation
- User direction and location tracking
- Avatar representation generation
- Visual information processing
- Real-time movement analysis

### Key Techniques
- Image processing and enhancement
- Feature extraction (edges, corners, textures)
- Object recognition and classification
- Depth estimation
- 3D reconstruction from 2D images

- Real-time rendering advancement
